observed: Hand-writing these M0 entries, `command` had no honest value — no anvil command exists yet to have captured them. Wrote `manual` rather than naming a command that never ran. §4.6 describes the field as 'which command captured it' and enumerates no values, so this needs confirming rather than assuming.
proposed_line: `command` may be `manual` for entries written by hand outside any command run.

observed: Routing these entries by hand, every behavioural category in §5 needs the same fingerprint in 2 distinct tickets, and every M0 entry has `ticket: null` because the corrections came from planning sessions with no ticket. No behavioural lesson captured before /scope exists can ever promote from these logs.
proposed_line: State how null-ticket entries count toward a distinct-ticket threshold.

observed: Presented six ticket drafts in one message and took a single approval covering all six, rather than one gate per run as SKILL.md section 5 describes.
proposed_line: When several drafts are presented together, an approval that does not name a draft is not approval of it.

observed: Wrote `.anvil/` in two prose sentences in skills/build/SKILL.md — not paths a skill resolves, but the path check greps the literal string and reported both. Rewrote them as ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.anvil/.
proposed_line: Write `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.anvil/` in prose as well as in paths; the check cannot tell them apart.

observed: Setting `version` in plugin.json made `claude plugin validate . --strict` pass. CRITICAL_PATHS.md still names the non-strict form, which passed with warnings all through M0-M6 and would keep passing if the manifest regressed.
proposed_line: Install — `claude plugin validate . --strict` exits 0; strict treats warnings as errors

observed: /setup is the first skill that emits Tree B file content rather than resolving a path, and the CONFIG.md example it must show contains a repo-relative `tickets:` value. The grep in CRITICAL_PATHS.md cannot tell a generated value from a resolved path and flagged it.
proposed_line: Path rule — the fence-aware awk over skills/*/SKILL.md returns nothing
